records.verifiedPremises: Hunter marks a player each night; actual killed or hanged Hunter pulls marked player; Jester wins on own real hanging only.
records.derivedBehaviorAndEngineering: Apply secondary death on same-round mark before terminal check; never count secondary death as hanging; dead target no duplicate.
records.conflictChecksAndLimits: Protection-free verified decks only. Stale mark fails atomically, no arbitrary duration; no general village winner.

records.conflictChecksAndLimits: All other players villagers, no secret-faction oracle. Mixed factions and competing death effects not enabled; no inferred village win.

records.derivedBehaviorAndEngineering: One current wolf only: one authoritative submission with 1 or 2 distinct targets; close all deaths before existing parity predicate.
records.conflictChecksAndLimits: Only two new decks, no hidden faction selection, no other defenses, multi-wolf consensus, post-conversion aura or retained seal behavior inferred.

records.conflictChecksAndLimits: Self-rescue is a logical derivation, not a separately approved owner rule; only pack bite, no other damage classes or overlapping rescue.
